newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyon-Satolas cargo growth up 8.8 pct in Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Lyon-Satolas cargo growth up 8.8 pct in Jan-Aug.

text.p: Airfreight traffic handled at Lyon-Satolas airport in the first eight months of the year totalled 13,630 tonnes, up 8.8 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.

The main factor in the strong growth was the volume carried on intra-EU routes, most of it in the form of express shipments, which rose by 13.6 percent on January-August 1995 to 6,018 tonnes, it added.
United Parcel Service of America Inc., DHL Worldwide Express and TNT Express Worldwide each operate air cargo services at Lyon-Satolas.
UPS recently launched feeder flights between Lyon and three other French cities -- Bordeaux, Toulouse and Nice -- earlier this month, using two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.
Postal traffic totalled 8,924 tonnes, up one percent on the first eight months of last year.
